title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 148 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 148 - Power to Impose Tax without Prejudice to Other Methods The power to impose tax by deduction or collection under this Part shall be exercised without prejudice to the power to levy tax by other methods.
